notes.title: It Consumes joins Bullet Heaven Festival 2.0 with a new demo
notes.content:
[h3]BULLET HEAVEN FEST 2.0[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43898717/44e94238fdf17cfbfce6f9aaa85e856a68c742fa.png[/img]

It Consumes is taking part in this year's edition of the Bullet Heaven Festival, which starts today!

To celebrate the event, an updated demo is now live. It includes several new perks, upgrades, and abilities, and it also adds the game's first boss.

I'd love to hear your feedback, so join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/KJb3VKxRtM]Discord[/url] if you haven't already and let me know what you think.

Now go check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/bulletheaven2]festival[/url] and play some demos!
